options.content:
**E0.4: worker threads fix.** Pick the run(s) in `testid` (top). Set **C** (jobs/s capacity, = workers / run time per job) in the top bar so the dashed line shows capacity.  
k6 attributes completions that arrive *after* a step ends to that step's tag, so for true throughput over time use the **server-side** panel, not the k6 ones. Server panels (queue, busy, wait/run, loop lag) have no `testid`; they follow the time range.

spec.title: /health latency (isolation check)
spec.description: Should stay flat while /cpu-worker is overloaded. 'max' is the upper bound of the highest populated native-histogram bucket (k6 has no separate _max series in native-histogram mode).

spec.title: Event-loop lag
spec.description: Raw = as reported by monitorEventLoopDelay (includes the 10 ms timer resolution as a floor). 'minus 10 ms' = real lag above that floor.

spec.title: B · /cpu-worker p99 latency by load step (all responses)
spec.description: One line per load_pct tag. Includes shed (503) and timeout responses.

spec.title: C · /cpu-worker p99 latency, successful only (status=200)
spec.description: Latency of requests that actually completed. Compare with B to see what shedding hides.

spec.title: Throughput: completed jobs/s (server-side)
spec.description: True worker throughput over time. Should plateau at C once the pool saturates.

spec.title: Goodput: successful responses/s (k6)
spec.description: status=200 responses per second as seen by the client.

spec.title: Shed and timed-out
spec.description: 503 = queue full (shed). status 0 = client timeout / connection error. 'rejected'/'failed' are the server-side outcomes of the same events.

spec.title: Queue length and busy workers
spec.description: Queue grows when arrival rate exceeds C. Busy workers (right axis) should pin at pool size.

spec.title: Wait vs run time (p50 / p99)
spec.description: Log scale. Run time stays ~constant; wait is the queueing delay and grows without bound under overload. Observed at job completion, so it lags the queue.

spec.title: In flight and dropped iterations
spec.description: Server in-flight and k6 VUs follow Little's Law (rate x latency). Dropped iterations (right axis) > 0 means k6 could not keep schedule: the generator is the bottleneck, discard the step.

spec.title: Server CPUs busy (per logical CPU)
spec.description: CPUs in the $server_cpus regex (top bar). Workers should spread over the pinned cores; SMT siblings share one physical core.

spec.title: Generator (k6) CPUs: headroom check
spec.description: CPUs in $gen_cpus. Keep below 70% (red line) or the result is not trustworthy.

spec.title: Memory (Node process)
spec.description: Watch for growth when the worker queue is unbounded (queued jobs hold request data).

spec.title: Achieved vs offered rate (k6)
spec.description: One line per offered_rps tag: requests/s that k6 recorded in that step.
